steps.title: Why Hybrid Cloud Matters
steps.text: Hybrid cloud provides high availability across provider outages, optimal latency via nearest-region routing, data sovereignty compliance, and cost optimization through multi-provider strategies.

steps.title: Multi-Cloud Architecture
steps.text: Deploy Surgewave clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP with cross-cloud replication. On-premise data centers connect through secure gateways and cloud sync agents.

steps.title: Replication Topologies
steps.text: Choose from active-passive for DR, active-active for global distribution, hub-spoke for central aggregation, or mesh for full redundancy based on your availability needs.

steps.title: Key Patterns
steps.text: Implement regional producer affinity for nearest-cluster writes, cross-region replication for data availability, and geo-aware consumer routing for local replica reads.

steps.title: Best Practices
steps.text: Use async replication to avoid critical-path latency, implement conflict resolution for active-active, monitor replication lag, test failover monthly, and encrypt cross-cloud traffic.
